classification_scope: Pure per-source interpretation of preserved v3 boundaries; no recapture or producer JSON changes. Capture, physical verification and fsync accounting unchanged from producer commit.

producer_classification.rule: input by deadline; no monotonic backlog growth across >=3 boundaries

current_per_source_classification.rule: input by deadline; per-source monotonic backlog with >=2 increases is non-steady

steady-n2.performance_use: Eligible starting observation only; compare matched per-source window_work, tail and background work in interleaved P1 A/B.
